title: Beyond Toxic: Toxicity Detection Datasets are Not Enough for Brand Safety
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The benchmark measured the F1-score of a text classification model for toxicity detection and brand safety on various datasets.
base_benchmarks: Automated Hate Speech Detection and the Problem of Offensive Language (AHS)
Jigsaw Unintended Bias in Toxicity Classification (JUB)
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the generalizability of toxicity detection models to the domain of brand safety.
